content:
maria_support: FYI customer GuestPay (tenant=guestpay-88) is seeing intermittent 504s and p95 spikes starting ~2026-03-18T14:10Z. They say requests sometimes never return and we see gateway 504 + \"deadline exceeded\" in their logs. Posting their repro curl and our gateway logs below.

maria_support: curl they used (sanitized):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"model":"gpt-neox-20b","input":"<~1200 tokens prompt>","max_tokens":800}'
```

maria_support: customer says: p95 jumped to ~1.2s then 5xx surge to 20% for a 10m window. They were not using streaming. Said they see multiple requests stuck with status=queued for >10s.

tim_oncall: Thanks Maria — grabbing traces and queue metrics now. Which region?

maria_support: us-east-1 for them. reported qps ~25-35, many long sequences. customer attached request ids: r_8f9c, r_8f9d, r_9012.

jun_eng_runtime: Looking at internal metrics for tenant guestpay-88 around 14:08-14:18Z: request_queue_depth peaked at ~172, continuous_batcher_pending increased steadily, kv_cache_evictions spiked. p95 at batcher stage ~1200ms. My quick read: backlog in continuous batching + KV cache thrash causing tail-latency timeouts.

jun_eng_runtime: snippets from internal logs: 
```
[2026-03-18T14:12:01Z] tenant=guestpay-88 enqueue request_id=r_8f9c queue_depth=168
[2026-03-18T14:12:01Z] batcher: pending=42 active_batches=6
[2026-03-18T14:12:02Z] runtime: kv-cache-evict tenant=guestpay-88 keys=2300
[2026-03-18T14:12:03Z] gateway: respond 504 request_id=r_8f9c reason=deadline_exceeded
```

sara_eng_infra: Can you confirm autoscaler state? deploy_bot — any autoscale events around that window?

deploy_bot: autoscaler:policy=continuous-batcher-autoscale region=us-east-1 tenant=guestpay-88 event=scale_up_attempt reason=queue_depth_threshold at 2026-03-18T14:13:04Z status=throttled (account limits)

deploy_bot: note: reserved capacity for guestpay-88 is 0 (hosted tier).

sara_eng_infra: That matches. Autoscaler attempted scale but hit global tenant quotas. If continuous batcher can't scale, queue backs up and tail latency explodes.

amy_cs: I messaged the customer with a short mitigation: 1) set max_tokens lower (<=256) 2) enable streaming (reduces gateway wait) 3) temporary request rate cap on their side. They implemented (1) and saw immediate drop in 5xx. We need an internal fix to avoid repeated hits.

jun_eng_runtime: Quick mitigations to propose: 
- enable tenant fallback to a smaller model variant when queue_depth > 120 
- temporarily reduce continuous batcher window for this tenant (lower max_batch_wait_ms) 
- tune kv-cache eviction thresholds to avoid thrash for long-context workloads

tim_oncall: For triage, I ran these queries (promql):
```
max_over_time(request_queue_depth{tenant="guestpay-88"}[15m])
rate(continuous_batcher_pending_total{tenant="guestpay-88"}[5m])
```
Results posted in the incident dashboard link: https://internal.redwood/obs/incident/3709991234

carter_product: We should add a product-level safety: auto-fallback to quantized-small model for sudden sustained queue depth for hosted tier. Also need clear messaging in docs for long-context customers about reserved capacity.

jun_eng_runtime: Agreed. Next steps I will: create a short-run playbook PR with runbook steps + an automated route change we can flip per-tenant. Will also add an alert on kv_cache_evictions rate for tenants with avg_tokens>800.

sara_eng_infra: I'll follow up to temporarily grant burst capacity for guestpay-88 for 30m to clear backlog; needs approval from cost ops.

tim_oncall: Until we push infra mitigations, workaround for oncall: 1) flip tenant fallback to small model 2) reduce batcher window 3) inform customer to reduce concurrency. Reproduce command:
```
for id in r_8f9c r_8f9d r_9012; do curl -H "X-Request-ID:$id" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-neox-20b","input":"<...>","max_tokens":800}' ; done
```

amy_cs: Customer accepted the short-term mitigation and confirmed 5xx dropped to ~0.5% after reducing max_tokens. They're asking for long-term SLA changes. Will coordinate sales/enterprise.

carter_product: Assigning postmortem owner (jun_eng_runtime) and product action item (carter_product). Please capture timelines, root cause (autoscaler throttle + kv thrash + long-context workload), and mitigations (fallbacks, autoscale quota checks, runbook).

maria_support: Thanks team — I'll keep the customer updated. Marking incident as monitoring while infra confirms burst grant.

tim_oncall: I'll leave a short runbook snippet in the incident doc before EOD.

jun_eng_runtime: Adding a link to my draft PR for playbook: https://internal.redwood/pull/6789 (contains commands to flip tenant fallback and adjust batcher window).

sara_eng_infra: cost-ops approved 30m burst for guestpay-88 at 14:30Z, request queue drained by ~14:40Z. Monitoring shows p95 returning to baseline.

maria_support: customer confirmed UX restored. Closing to monitoring.
